name: Kevin Wu
headline: CEO at Leaping AI | Digital call center workers
location: San Francisco, United States of America
summary: Currently building Leaping AI out of San Francisco / Berlin. Leaping AI makes digital workers for call centers that are human-like, automate 70% of the calls end to end and make your operations more productive. For one home remodelling company, we were able reduce call center costs by >50%, increase appointment set rate by +5% and optimise speed to lead to 7 seconds. For a travel company, we are automating 50% of booking-related support requests over the phone in 5 languages in over 10 countries.
